core_obligations: Take an associated prime of the kernel and describe it through an element of the localisation (proof lines 5442-5445).
Show this contradicts both alternatives of the hypothesis (proof lines 5446-5447).
Conclude that the kernel has no associated primes and hence is zero (proof lines 5448-5450).
proof_roadmap: Associated prime of the kernel (proof lines 5442-5445).
No associated primes implies zero (proof lines 5448-5450).
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a local criterion for a map of modules over a Noetherian ring to be injective: at every prime either the map is injective after localising or the prime is not associated to the source. The proof takes an associated prime of the kernel, uses the standard description of such a prime to produce an element of the localised source which lies in the kernel of the localised map and whose annihilator is that prime, and observes that this contradicts both cases of the hypothesis. Hence the kernel has no associated primes and therefore vanishes.
